title: Invisible Trapped Chest
description: This pack allows you to hide trapped chests and make them indistinguishable from normal chests.
body:
## Description

This pack makes the **trapped chest completely indistinguishable from the regular chest**:  
- The trapped chest uses **the exact same texture** as the normal chest.  
- There is **no visual difference** at all, even under close inspection.  

---

## Example Uses

- **Server Use**: Perfect as a server resource pack, making the trapped chest visually identical for all players.  
- **Map Makers**: Useful to hide the distracting red tint while still keeping the redstone functionality intact.  
- **Mini-games**: Great for mini-games or chance-based setups like a Russian roulette chest challenge.  


---
